notes: Scripts are relative to the folder containing cron_master_scheduler.php.
One Hostinger cron calls cron_master_scheduler.php every minute.
race_results_monitor uses type auto_race_monitor; _race_results_schedule.json supplies next-race timing.
race_results_revision_monitor uses type auto_revision_monitor; it stays on normal daily times until a new final-result handoff is detected, then temporarily increases cadence.

race_results_monitor.description: Race-aware monitor schedule driven by _race_results_schedule.json next_race.start_at and _race_results_monitor_state.json lap/final state.

race_results_revision_monitor.description: Revision-aware schedule. Normal daily checks are used until a new final-result handoff is detected; then revision monitor runs more frequently for post-race stabilization before scaling back.
